name: claim-check
description: Sends your coding agent back when it says "done" or "not found" without showing proof.

enabled.title: Check claims
enabled.description: When off, the Stop hook does not run. Saved in your user settings; a project cannot set it.

log_only.title: Log only
log_only.description: Log claims that would have been blocked, and let the turn end. Saved in your user settings; a project cannot set it.
